title: renderDriverActive
responsibility: Render the driver active counts, totals and job table in the existing ACTIVE.md format without changing files.

inputs.name: renderDriverActive.state
inputs.description: Active driver snapshot to render. Adapter render defaults to a fresh read; dead PIDs are filtered by active(), not by the formatter.

outputs.name: renderDriverActive
outputs.description: Markdown counts, totals and ordered active-job table compatible with ACTIVE.md.
